raw_segments.text: There was a tray ready on a side table. I brought it to the table near the fire and
asked him what he would have. He touched one of the bottles without looking at it or speaking,
and I made him some hot rum and water. I tried to keep my hand steady while I did so, but
his look at me as he leaned back in his chair with the long, draggled end of his neckerchief
between his teeth, evidently forgotten, made my hand very difficult to master.
When at last I put the glass to him, I saw with amazement that his eyes were full of tears.
